description: Ask her to shoot something NEW this moment — not one of the pictures she already has (those are in whoami's `photos` / `videos`). Use it when the person asks for a picture of her right now. It spends the account's credits and is capped per hour, so do not call it on your own initiative and never retry a refusal in a loop. `photo` comes back immediately with a URL; `video` takes about 95 seconds (measured) and arrives later in `read_chat_history`.

host_id.description: The host's id. Optional when SOUL37_HOST_ID is set — then it defaults to the bound host.

kind.description: `photo` is instant. `video` is asynchronous and costs much more — only when they asked for a video.

name: shoot
title: Have her take a new photo or video right now
